title: Bind row on the story card
caption: Basic at 1500 px on Crash Site Rendezvous: under the story text, one tick row says to bind Galorik's Inspection Area on the way, 49 m from Ulgorn.

title: Bind row in Advanced
caption: The same row in Advanced: one row inside the story card, not a card of its own; ticking it marks that Kibelisk bound.

title: Bind row on a phone
caption: On a phone in Basic the row sits under the card text and above the Turned in button; the whole row is the tick target.

title: Bind row on a phone, Advanced
caption: On a phone in Advanced the featured story card shows the same row; other cards stay compact.
